**Activer** : cocher la case pour active: **Enable**: Check the box to enable the repeat function and display the corresponding options.
**Ajouter une date** : permet, depuis un: **Add a Date**: Allows you to add a date to an event from within a scenario. You can add multiple dates by separating them with commas *(note: if you change the event’s name, you’ll need to update it in the scenario)*.
**Catégorie** : Permet de choisir la cat: **Category**: Allows you to select the category of the device.
**Couleur de fond** : permet de choisir: **Background Color**: Allows you to choose the background color of the event *(check the box for a transparent background)*.
**Couleur du texte** : permet de choisir: **Text Color**: Allows you to choose the color of the event text.
**Dupliquer** : permet de dupliquer l'év: **Duplicate**: allows you to duplicate the event to create a new one *(be sure to save the new event that is created)*.
**En cours** : donne la liste des évènem: **In Progress**: Returns a comma-separated list of events currently in progress. To use this in a scenario, the simplest way is to use the *"contains"* (``matches``) or *"does not contain"* (``not matches``) operator *(example: ``[Apartment][test][In Progress] matches "/Birthday/"`` will be true if "Birthday" is in the list of current events)*.
**Exclure par agenda** : permet de mettr: **Exclude by calendar**: allows you to exclude this event based on another calendar or event *(to prevent two conflicting events from occurring at the same time, for example)*.
**Exclure par date** : idem que **Inclur: **Exclude by date**: Same as **Include by date**, but used to ignore certain instances.
**Fin** : date de fin de l'évènement *(l: **End**: Event end date *(the icon at the end of the line lets you set the event to last all day)*.
**Fréquence** : permet de choisir une ré: **Frequency**: allows you to set a recurring event, for example, every second Monday of the month...
**Icône** : permet d’ajouter une icône d: **Icon**: Allows you to add an icon before the event name *(click the "Choose an icon" button)*.
**Inclure par agenda** : permet d’inclur: **Include by calendar**: allows you to include occurrences based on those of another calendar or another event. For example, if you have an event ``A`` that repeats every Monday and you include it in your current event, your current event will also repeat every Monday.
**Inclure par date** : permet d'ajouter: **Include by Date**: allows you to add a date of occurrence. You can specify multiple dates by separating them with ``, (commas)`` *(example: YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD)*. It is also possible to define a date range using ``: (colon)`` *(example: YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD)*.
**Jusqu’à** : dernière date d’occurrence: **Until**: the latest date on which the event occurs.
**Liste des évènements de l’agenda** : a: **Calendar Event List**: Displays a list of all calendar events *(click on a name to edit the event)*.
**Masquer sur le widget** : permet de ne: **Hide on the widget**: Prevents this event from being displayed on the widget.
**Nom de agenda** : Nom de l'équipement: **Calendar Name**: Name of the Calendar device.
**Nombre de jours** : défini le nombre d: **Number of days**: Sets the maximum number of days to display on the widget.
**Nombre d’évènements** : défini le nomb: **Number of events**: Sets the maximum number of events to display on the widget.
**Objet parent** : Indique l’objet paren: **Parent Object**: Specifies the parent object to which the device belongs.
**Restriction** : permet d’exclure les j: **Restriction**: Allows you to exclude holidays or restrict the event to holidays / even weeks / odd weeks only.
**Retirer une date** : permet, depuis un: **Remove a Date**: Allows you to remove a date from an event within a scenario. You can remove multiple dates by separating them with commas *(note: if you change the event name, you’ll need to update it in the scenario)*.
**Répéter tous les** : permet de définir: **Repeat every**: allows you to set the frequency at which the event repeats *(every 3 days, every 2 months, etc…​)*.
**Supprimer** : permet de supprimer l'év: **Delete**: Deletes the entire event or just a single occurrence.
**Uniquement les** : permet de restreind: **Only on**: allows you to restrict the repeat to certain days of the week.
**event::byId** permet de récupérer un é: **event::byId** retrieves an event based on its ID
**event::getAllEvents** permet de récupé: **event::getAllEvents** retrieves all events from a calendar
**event::save** permet de créer / modifi: **event::save** allows you to create or modify an event
